notes.title: a Difficult update about Wheelchair
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi there![/h2]

For the past two months, we’ve been working hard to bring this major update to life. We focused on fine-tuning the controls and improving levels to make the game even more [i]difficult[/i]!

[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Forest[/b] and [b]Construction[/b] levels have been extended with more obstacles and challenges.
[*] A brand-new [b]Amusement Park / Circus[/b] level with lots of interactive blocks!
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] We heard your feedback on the [b]camera[/b], so we’ve made it smoother and added a free-look feature.
[*] [b]Auto-saving[/b] is here! Come back anytime and keep your progress.
[*] Basic configuration [b]options[/b] added.
[/list]

Update the game and don’t let the wheels get cold!
